sailors.biography:
Born on August 2, 2011, in Istanbul, I completed my early education at TED Rönesans College. In 2017, my family and I relocated to Izmir Urla. At TED Izmir College, I graduated third in primary school and continued to excel, securing third place in both the 5th and 6th grades. My journey into sports began early at the age of 5 with gymnastics and running, which I pursued until I turned 8. During the summer of 2019, under the guidance of my coach Emirşah Polat at EMR Windsurf school, I ventured into windsurfing, marking a new chapter in my athletic endeavors. 

Dedicated summer and winter training, coupled with intense fitness regimen, propelled me to success in national competitions. After three years of rigorous preparation, I achieved remarkable milestones in various races, eventually reaching international championship levels in the fourth year. My ultimate aspiration is to represent my country in numerous global competitions and the prestigious Olympics as an accomplished Olympic athlete in IQ Foil, an Olympic-class event.

Achievements:
- 2022-2023 Techno 293 U13 and U15 National and International Race Rankings
- 2022 April Cup U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Turkish Inter-School Championship U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Decathlon Sailing Races U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Atatürk Commemoration Cup U15 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Victory Day U13 Girls 2nd Place
- 2023 Türkiye Inter-School Championship U15 Girls 2nd Place
- 2023 Stars Cup National Team Selection Races Türkiye 2nd Place
- 2023 European Championship Italy U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2023 World Championship France U13 Girls 1st Place

sailors.biography:
Born on August 2, 2011, in Istanbul, I completed my early education at TED Rönesans College. In 2017, my family and I relocated to Izmir Urla. At TED Izmir College, I graduated third in primary school and continued to excel, securing third place in both the 5th and 6th grades. My journey into sports began early at the age of 5 with gymnastics and running, which I pursued until I turned 8. During the summer of 2019, under the guidance of my coach Emirşah Polat at EMR Windsurf school, I ventured into windsurfing, marking a new chapter in my athletic endeavors. 

Dedicated summer and winter training, coupled with intense fitness regimen, propelled me to success in national competitions. After three years of rigorous preparation, I achieved remarkable milestones in various races, eventually reaching international championship levels in the fourth year. My ultimate aspiration is to represent my country in numerous global competitions and the prestigious Olympics as an accomplished Olympic athlete in IQ Foil, an Olympic-class event.

Achievements:
- 2022-2023 Techno 293 U13 and U15 National and International Race Rankings
- 2022 April Cup U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Turkish Inter-School Championship U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Decathlon Sailing Races U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Atatürk Commemoration Cup U15 Girls 1st Place
- 2022 Victory Day U13 Girls 2nd Place
- 2023 Türkiye Inter-School Championship U15 Girls 2nd Place
- 2023 Stars Cup National Team Selection Races Türkiye 2nd Place
- 2023 European Championship Italy U13 Girls 1st Place
- 2023 World Championship France U13 Girls 1st Place
